name: fill-read-through
rule: src/optimize.ts readThroughFills: get A k on a fill-run fold, element index provably below the trip count (upperBound(k) < count, or canonical count == length so the index is rem k length), becomes f(index, extras); f limited to FUSE_RECOMPUTE_COST (4 nodeCost units); the fold is dead when no read remains
wasm_evidence_method: byte decode of the arrfill function body from compile(program, 'wasm'): local.get/i32.add/i32.const/i32.and/local.set only; no 0x28 i32.load or 0x36 i32.store

timing.reason: Win32_Processor LoadPercentage was 100 on five consecutive samples (threshold 25); no wasm-ab samples taken
